title: SKSMPMC
description: Lifesteal Cpvp SMP with custom weapon skins and so much more!
body:
**SKSMPMC is a high-performance Survival CPvP Lifesteal** server designed for players seeking fast-paced PvP, grinding, and genuine competition.

**Enter a 15,000 x 15,000** world with ample room for exploration, building, raiding, and dominance. From beginning to endgame, progression feels seamless, satisfying, and equitable when paired with a well-balanced donut-style economy.

**With CS2-inspired skins and cases**, you can stand out in battles and unlock sleek, contemporary cosmetics while maintaining a competitive gameplay. Just skill, strategy, and astute grinding.
 
**SKSMPMC offers a polished and competitive survival experience** whether you are pursuing kills, accumulating wealth or creating your own empire.
